meta.fullName: Success with English（广州市教育研究院编）
meta.coverage: 小学一年级、二年级（共 4 册）
meta.publisher: 广州出版社 / 福建教育出版社
meta.note: 每册 5 个 Unit（第四册目录实测）；其它册单元数待核对

lessons.title: Let's Learn
lessons.en:
hello    hi    goodbye    bye
I'm Andy.    My name is Lily.
lessons.cn:
你好  嗨  再见  拜拜
我是安迪。  我叫莉莉。

lessons.title: Let's Talk
lessons.en:
Andy: Hello! I'm Andy.
Lily: Hi, Andy! I'm Lily.
Andy: Nice to meet you.
Lily: Nice to meet you, too.
Miss Li: Hello, children!
Andy: Hello, Miss Li!
lessons.cn:
安迪：你好！我是安迪。
莉莉：嗨，安迪！我是莉莉。
安迪：很高兴认识你。
莉莉：我也很高兴认识你。
李老师：同学们好！
安迪：李老师好！

lessons.title: Let's Chant — Hello
lessons.en:
Hello, hello, hello to you!
Hi, hi, hi, my name is Sue.
Goodbye, goodbye, see you soon!
Bye-bye, bye-bye, this afternoon.
lessons.cn:
你好，你好，向你问好！
嗨，嗨，嗨，我叫苏。
再见，再见，回头见！
拜拜，拜拜，下午见。

上.title: Unit 2 I Have a New Bag

lessons.title: Let's Learn
lessons.en:
a bag    a pen    a pencil    a book
a ruler    an eraser    a pencil-case
lessons.cn:
一个书包  一支钢笔  一支铅笔  一本书
一把尺子  一块橡皮  一个文具盒

lessons.title: Let's Talk
lessons.en:
Andy: I have a new bag.
Lily: Wow! It's nice.
Andy: This is my pen, and this is my pencil.
Lily: Show me your book, please.
Andy: Here you are.
Lily: Thank you!
lessons.cn:
安迪：我有一个新书包。
莉莉：哇！真好看。
安迪：这是我的钢笔，这是我的铅笔。
莉莉：请把你的书给我看看。
安迪：给你。
莉莉：谢谢！

lessons.title: Let's Chant — My Bag
lessons.en:
Bag, bag, a brand-new bag,
Pen, pen, a little red pen.
Book, book, open the book,
Pencil, pencil, write again!
lessons.cn:
书包，书包，崭新的书包，
钢笔，钢笔，小小的红钢笔。
书本，书本，把书翻开，
铅笔，铅笔，再写一遍！

上.title: Unit 3 Count from One to Ten

lessons.title: Let's Learn
lessons.en:
one    two    three    four    five
six    seven    eight    nine    ten
lessons.cn:
一  二  三  四  五
六  七  八  九  十

lessons.title: Let's Talk
lessons.en:
Teacher: Let's count! One, two, three.
Andy: Four, five, six.
Lily: Seven, eight, nine, ten!
Teacher: How many pens, Andy?
Andy: Three pens.
Teacher: Good job!
lessons.cn:
老师：我们来数数！一、二、三。
安迪：四、五、六。
莉莉：七、八、九、十！
老师：安迪，有几支钢笔？
安迪：三支钢笔。
老师：做得好！

lessons.title: Let's Chant — Count with Me
lessons.en:
One, two, three, clap with me!
Four, five, six, pick up sticks!
Seven, eight, nine, you are fine!
Ten, ten, ten, let's count again!
lessons.cn:
一、二、三，和我一起拍手！
四、五、六，把小棒捡起来！
七、八、九，你真棒！
十、十、十，我们再数一遍！

lessons.title: Let's Learn
lessons.en:
green    red    blue    yellow
orange    purple    pink    black    white
lessons.cn:
绿色  红色  蓝色  黄色
橙色  紫色  粉色  黑色  白色

lessons.title: Let's Talk
lessons.en:
Andy: I like green. Green is my favourite colour.
Lily: I like red and pink.
Andy: What colour is your bag?
Lily: It's blue.
Andy: Blue is nice, too!
lessons.cn:
安迪：我喜欢绿色。绿色是我最喜欢的颜色。
莉莉：我喜欢红色和粉色。
安迪：你的书包是什么颜色？
莉莉：是蓝色的。
安迪：蓝色也很好看！

lessons.title: Let's Chant — Colours
lessons.en:
Green, green, the grass is green.
Red, red, the apple's red.
Blue, blue, the sky is blue.
I like colours — how about you?
lessons.cn:
绿色，绿色，草儿绿。
红色，红色，苹果红。
蓝色，蓝色，天空蓝。
我喜欢颜色——你呢？

lessons.title: Let's Learn
lessons.en:
a scooter    a bike    a ball    a kite
a car    a doll    a robot    a train
lessons.cn:
一辆滑板车  一辆自行车  一个球  一只风筝
一辆小汽车  一个洋娃娃  一个机器人  一列火车

lessons.title: Let's Talk
lessons.en:
Andy: Here's my scooter. It's cool!
Lily: I have a kite. Look!
Andy: Wow! Let's play.
Ben: Can I play, too?
Andy: Sure! Here you are.
Ben: Thank you, Andy!
lessons.cn:
安迪：这是我的滑板车。它很酷！
莉莉：我有一只风筝。看！
安迪：哇！我们一起玩吧。
本：我也能一起玩吗？
安迪：当然！给你。
本：谢谢你，安迪！

lessons.title: Let's Chant — My Toys
lessons.en:
Scooter, scooter, go, go, go!
Kite, kite, up you fly!
Ball, ball, throw it high!
Toys, toys, let's all play!
lessons.cn:
滑板车，滑板车，冲冲冲！
风筝，风筝，飞上天！
皮球，皮球，抛得高！
玩具，玩具，一起玩！

lessons.title: Let's Learn
lessons.en:
jump    run    swim    dance
sing    fly    walk    climb
lessons.cn:
跳  跑  游泳  跳舞
唱歌  飞  走  爬

lessons.title: Let's Talk
lessons.en:
Andy: I can jump. Look at me!
Lily: I can dance. Can you dance?
Andy: Yes, I can. But I can't swim.
Ben: I can swim and run.
Lily: Wow! You're great.
lessons.cn:
安迪：我会跳。看我！
莉莉：我会跳舞。你会跳舞吗？
安迪：会的。但我不会游泳。
本：我会游泳，也会跑步。
莉莉：哇！你真棒。

lessons.title: Let's Chant — I Can
lessons.en:
Jump, jump, I can jump!
Run, run, run with fun!
Swim, swim, in we go!
Sing and dance — here we go!
lessons.cn:
跳，跳，我会跳！
跑，跑，开心地跑！
游，游，下水喽！
又唱又跳——出发啦！

lessons.title: Let's Learn
lessons.en:
dad    mum    brother    sister
grandpa    grandma    baby
lessons.cn:
爸爸  妈妈  哥哥/弟弟  姐姐/妹妹
爷爷  奶奶  婴儿

lessons.title: Let's Talk
lessons.en:
Andy: This is my family.
Lily: Who is he?
Andy: He is my dad. And she is my mum.
Lily: Is this your sister?
Andy: Yes. And this is my baby brother.
Lily: What a happy family!
lessons.cn:
安迪：这是我的家庭。
莉莉：他是谁？
安迪：他是我爸爸，她是我妈妈。
莉莉：这是你姐姐吗？
安迪：是的。这是我的小弟弟。
莉莉：多幸福的一家人！

lessons.title: Let's Chant — My Family
lessons.en:
Daddy, mummy, I love you,
Grandpa, grandma, love you too.
Sister, brother, baby small,
One big family — love them all!
lessons.cn:
爸爸，妈妈，我爱你，
爷爷，奶奶，也爱你。
姐姐，弟弟，小宝宝，
一个大家——都爱你！

lessons.title: Let's Learn
lessons.en:
house    home    door    window
come in    welcome    sofa
lessons.cn:
房子  家  门  窗户
进来  欢迎  沙发

lessons.title: Let's Talk
lessons.en:
Andy: Come to my house, Lily.
Lily: Wow, it's a big house!
Andy: Come in, please.
Lily: Thank you.
Andy: Sit on the sofa.
Lily: Your home is so nice!
lessons.cn:
安迪：来我家吧，莉莉。
莉莉：哇，好大的房子！
安迪：请进。
莉莉：谢谢。
安迪：坐在沙发上吧。
莉莉：你家真漂亮！

lessons.title: Let's Chant — Come In
lessons.en:
Knock, knock, open the door,
Welcome, welcome, come on in!
Sit, sit, on the sofa,
My sweet home — let's begin!
lessons.cn:
咚，咚，把门打开，
欢迎，欢迎，快进来！
坐，坐，沙发上坐，
我的家——开始啦！

words.example: The book is on the desk.

lessons.title: Let's Learn
lessons.en:
room    bed    desk    chair
lamp    clock    toy box
lessons.cn:
房间  床  书桌  椅子
台灯  钟  玩具箱

lessons.title: Let's Talk
lessons.en:
Lily: This is my room.
Andy: It's so tidy!
Lily: My bed is here. My desk is there.
Andy: What's on the desk?
Lily: A lamp and a clock.
Andy: I like your room!
lessons.cn:
莉莉：这是我的房间。
安迪：真整洁！
莉莉：我的床在这儿，书桌在那儿。
安迪：书桌上有什么？
莉莉：一盏台灯和一个钟。
安迪：我喜欢你的房间！

lessons.title: Let's Chant — My Room
lessons.en:
Bed, bed, time for bed,
Desk, desk, books are read.
Lamp, lamp, shining bright,
My tidy room — good night!
lessons.cn:
床，床，睡觉啦，
桌，桌，读读书。
灯，灯，亮晶晶，
整洁房间——晚安喽！

lessons.title: Let's Learn
lessons.en:
bird    tree    flower    fish
sun    cloud
lessons.cn:
鸟  树  花  鱼
太阳  云

lessons.title: Let's Talk
lessons.en:
Andy: Look! What do you see?
Lily: I see a bird in the tree.
Andy: I see pretty flowers.
Lily: I see the sun and white clouds.
Andy: What a beautiful day!
lessons.cn:
安迪：看！你看见了什么？
莉莉：我看见树上有一只鸟。
安迪：我看见漂亮的花。
莉莉：我看见太阳和白云。
安迪：多美的一天！

lessons.title: Let's Chant — I Can See
lessons.en:
Look, look, what do you see?
A little bird in the tree!
Look, look, up in the sky,
The sun, the clouds, way up high!
lessons.cn:
看，看，你看见啥？
树上一只小小鸟！
看，看，天上瞧，
太阳白云高又高！

lessons.title: Let's Learn
lessons.en:
pet    dog    cat    rabbit
fish    turtle
lessons.cn:
宠物  狗  猫  兔子
鱼  乌龟

lessons.title: Let's Talk
lessons.en:
Lily: I want a pet.
Mum: What pet do you want?
Lily: I want a little rabbit. It's so cute.
Mum: OK. Let's take care of it.
Lily: Thank you, mum!
lessons.cn:
莉莉：我想要一只宠物。
妈妈：你想要什么宠物？
莉莉：我想要一只小兔子，太可爱了。
妈妈：好的，我们一起照顾它。
莉莉：谢谢妈妈！

lessons.title: Let's Chant — My Pet
lessons.en:
Dog, dog, woof woof woof,
Cat, cat, on the roof.
Rabbit, rabbit, hop hop hop,
I love pets — they never stop!
lessons.cn:
狗，狗，汪汪汪，
猫，猫，房顶上。
兔，兔，蹦蹦跳，
我爱宠物——停不了！

lessons.title: Let's Learn
lessons.en:
ice-cream    cake    candy    juice
milk    bread    apple
lessons.cn:
冰淇淋  蛋糕  糖果  果汁
牛奶  面包  苹果

lessons.title: Let's Talk
lessons.en:
Andy: I want ice-cream!
Mum: Here you are.
Andy: Yummy! Can I have some cake?
Mum: Sure. And drink some milk.
Andy: Thank you, mum. It's yummy!
lessons.cn:
安迪：我想要冰淇淋！
妈妈：给你。
安迪：好吃！我能吃点蛋糕吗？
妈妈：当然，再喝点牛奶。
安迪：谢谢妈妈，真好吃！

lessons.title: Let's Chant — Yummy Food
lessons.en:
Ice-cream, ice-cream, cold and sweet,
Cake and candy, what a treat!
Milk and juice, yummy, yum,
Clap your hands and rub your tum!
lessons.cn:
冰淇淋，冰淇淋，又凉又甜，
蛋糕糖果，真过瘾！
牛奶果汁，香又甜，
拍拍手来摸摸肚！

lessons.title: Let's Learn
lessons.en:
sing    dance    draw    swim
skate    ride    play
lessons.cn:
唱歌  跳舞  画画  游泳
滑冰  骑  玩/演奏

lessons.title: Let's Talk
lessons.en:
Andy: What can you do, Lily?
Lily: I can dance and draw. What about you?
Andy: I can swim and ride a bike.
Ben: I can play football!
Lily: Wow, we can do many things!
lessons.cn:
安迪：你会做什么，莉莉？
莉莉：我会跳舞和画画。你呢？
安迪：我会游泳和骑车。
本：我会踢足球！
莉莉：哇，我们会做好多事！

lessons.title: Let's Chant — I Can
lessons.en:
I can sing, I can dance,
I can draw, give me a chance!
I can swim, I can ride,
Look at me — I try with pride!
lessons.cn:
我会唱，我会跳，
我会画，给我机会瞧！
我会游，我会骑，
看看我——真神气！

lessons.title: Let's Learn
lessons.en:
rice    noodles    soup    fish
chicken    egg    vegetable
lessons.cn:
米饭  面条  汤  鱼
鸡肉  鸡蛋  蔬菜

lessons.title: Let's Talk
lessons.en:
Andy: Mum, I'm hungry. What's for dinner?
Mum: Rice, fish and vegetables.
Andy: Yummy! I like fish.
Mum: Eat your vegetables, too.
Andy: OK. Let's eat!
lessons.cn:
安迪：妈妈，我饿了。晚饭吃什么？
妈妈：米饭、鱼和蔬菜。
安迪：好吃！我喜欢鱼。
妈妈：也要吃蔬菜哦。
安迪：好的，开吃！

lessons.title: Let's Chant — Dinner Time
lessons.en:
Rice and fish, on my dish,
Soup and noodles, what a wish!
Vegetables green, good for you,
Dinner time — yummy, too!
lessons.cn:
米饭和鱼，盘中餐，
汤和面条，多美满！
绿色蔬菜，身体好，
晚饭时间——真叫妙！

上.title: Unit 3 At the Zoo（待核对）
上.note: 原抓取为 It's a Nice T-shirt，但该主题实为第四册 Unit 1，本单元标题待核对

lessons.title: Let's Learn
lessons.en:
lion    tiger    monkey    elephant
panda    bear
lessons.cn:
狮子  老虎  猴子  大象
熊猫  熊

lessons.title: Let's Talk
lessons.en:
Andy: Let's go to the zoo!
Lily: Great! Look, a big elephant.
Andy: I can see two pandas. They're cute.
Ben: Look at the monkey. It jumps!
Lily: I love the zoo!
lessons.cn:
安迪：我们去动物园吧！
莉莉：太好了！看，一头大象。
安迪：我看见两只熊猫，好可爱。
本：看那只猴子，它在跳！
莉莉：我爱动物园！

lessons.title: Let's Chant — At the Zoo
lessons.en:
Lion, lion, big and strong,
Monkey, monkey, jump along.
Panda, panda, black and white,
At the zoo — what a sight!
lessons.cn:
狮子，狮子，强又壮，
猴子，猴子，蹦蹦跳。
熊猫，熊猫，黑又白，
动物园里——真好看！

lessons.title: Let's Learn
lessons.en:
morning    noon    afternoon
evening    night    o'clock
lessons.cn:
早晨  中午  下午
傍晚  夜晚  ……点钟

lessons.title: Let's Talk
lessons.en:
Andy: What time is it now?
Lily: It's seven o'clock.
Andy: Time to get up!
Lily: It's twelve o'clock. Time for lunch.
Andy: It's nine o'clock at night. Good night!
lessons.cn:
安迪：现在几点了？
莉莉：七点钟。
安迪：该起床啦！
莉莉：十二点了，该吃午饭。
安迪：晚上九点了，晚安！

lessons.title: Let's Chant — What Time
lessons.en:
Tick-tock, tick-tock, what time now?
Seven o'clock, get up — wow!
Twelve o'clock, time to eat,
Nine at night, sleep so sweet!
lessons.cn:
滴答，滴答，几点啦？
七点钟，快起床——哇！
十二点，吃饭喽，
夜里九点，睡好觉！

lessons.title: Let's Learn
lessons.en:
skating    running    jumping
swimming    riding    playing
lessons.cn:
滑冰  跑步  跳
游泳  骑车  玩

lessons.title: Let's Talk
lessons.en:
Lily: Where are you, Andy?
Andy: I'm in the park. I'm skating!
Lily: That's fun! Ben is running.
Andy: Look, the girls are jumping.
Lily: Let's play together!
lessons.cn:
莉莉：你在哪儿，安迪？
安迪：我在公园，我在滑冰！
莉莉：真好玩！本在跑步。
安迪：看，女孩们在跳。
莉莉：我们一起玩吧！

lessons.title: Let's Chant — In the Park
lessons.en:
Skating, skating, round we go,
Running, running, fast not slow.
Jumping, jumping, high and free,
In the park — come play with me!
lessons.cn:
滑冰，滑冰，转圈圈，
跑步，跑步，快如箭。
跳跃，跳跃，又高又欢，
公园里——来玩耍！

lessons.title: Let's Learn
lessons.en:
washing    cooking    cleaning
reading    writing    watching TV
lessons.cn:
洗  做饭  打扫
读书  写字  看电视

lessons.title: Let's Talk
lessons.en:
Andy: What are you doing, mum?
Mum: I'm washing up. Dad is cooking.
Andy: Can I help you?
Mum: Yes! Please clean the table.
Andy: OK, mum. We're a busy family!
lessons.cn:
安迪：妈妈，你在做什么？
妈妈：我在洗碗，爸爸在做饭。
安迪：我能帮忙吗？
妈妈：好呀！请擦擦桌子。
安迪：好的妈妈，我们一家真忙！

lessons.title: Let's Chant — Busy Day
lessons.en:
Mum is washing, dad can cook,
Sister's reading a big book.
Clean and help, one, two, three,
A busy family — you and me!
lessons.cn:
妈妈洗碗，爸爸做饭，
姐姐读着大书本。
打扫帮忙，一二三，
忙碌一家——你和我！

words.example: Here is my T-shirt. It's purple.
Here is my sweater. It is blue.
A red skirt on the bed.
Here is my jacket. It's yellow.

lessons.title: Let's Learn
lessons.en:
a T-shirt    a dress    a skirt    a shirt
a sweater    socks    shoes    jeans    shorts
lessons.cn:
一件 T 恤衫    一条连衣裙    一条短裙    一件衬衫
一件毛衣    袜子    鞋子    牛仔裤    短裤

lessons.title: Let's Sing — MY CLOTHES
lessons.en:
Here is my T-shirt.
It's purple.
Here is my sweater.
It is blue.
Here is my jacket.
It's yellow.
It is yellow. It is new.
lessons.cn:
这是我的 T 恤衫，
它是紫色的。
这是我的毛衣，
它是蓝色的。
这是我的夹克衫，
它是黄色的。
它是黄色的，是新的。

lessons.title: Let's Chant — Socks
lessons.en:
Socks purple, socks red,
Socks yellow on the bed.

Socks, socks, everywhere,
On the table, under the chair.

Socks here, socks there,
Socks, socks, everywhere.
lessons.cn:
紫色的袜子，红色的袜子，
黄色的袜子在床上。

袜子，袜子，到处都是袜子，
桌子上，椅子下。

这里有袜子，那里也有袜子，
袜子，袜子，到处都是。

lessons.title: Let's Play — Choose, say and guess
lessons.en:
— She's wearing a yellow dress and blue shoes. Who's she?
— Girl 2.
lessons.cn:
—— 她穿着一条黄色的连衣裙和一双蓝色的鞋子，她是谁？
—— 2 号女孩。

下.title: Unit 2 I Go to School by Bus

words.example: I go to school by bus.

lessons.title: Let's Learn
lessons.en:
bus    car    bike    taxi
train    on foot
lessons.cn:
公交车  小汽车  自行车  出租车
火车  步行

lessons.title: Let's Talk
lessons.en:
Andy: How do you go to school?
Lily: I go to school by bus. And you?
Andy: I go by bike. It's fast.
Ben: I go on foot. My home is near.
Lily: Cool!
lessons.cn:
安迪：你怎么去上学？
莉莉：我坐公交车上学。你呢？
安迪：我骑自行车，很快。
本：我走路，我家很近。
莉莉：真棒！

lessons.title: Let's Chant — Go to School
lessons.en:
Bus, bus, beep beep beep,
Bike, bike, fast not slow.
Train, train, choo choo choo,
Go to school — off we go!
lessons.cn:
公交，公交，嘀嘀嘀，
单车，单车，快快骑。
火车，火车，呜呜呜，
去上学——出发咯！

lessons.title: Let's Learn

teacher    doctor    nurse

lessons.title: Let's Talk
lessons.en:
Andy: What do you want to be, Lily?
Lily: I want to be a teacher. And you?
Andy: I want to be a doctor. I can help people.
Ben: I want to be a driver!
Lily: Great jobs!
lessons.cn:
安迪：你想成为什么，莉莉？
莉莉：我想当老师。你呢？
安迪：我想当医生，可以帮助别人。
本：我想当司机！
莉莉：都是好工作！

lessons.title: Let's Chant — My Dream
lessons.en:
Teacher, doctor, nurse and cook,
Farmer, driver, take a look!
What do you want to be one day?
A happy job — hip hip hooray!
lessons.cn:
老师，医生，护士，厨师，
农民，司机，快来看！
将来你想做什么？
快乐工作——耶耶耶！

lessons.title: Let's Learn

park    zoo    shop

公园  动物园  商店

lessons.title: Let's Talk
lessons.en:
Lily: Dad, please take me to the park.
Dad: OK. Let's go now.
Lily: Can we go to the zoo, too?
Dad: Sure. There are pandas.
Lily: Yeah! I'm so happy!
lessons.cn:
莉莉：爸爸，请带我去公园。
爸爸：好的，我们现在就去。
莉莉：我们也能去动物园吗？
爸爸：当然，那里有熊猫。
莉莉：耶！我太开心了！

lessons.title: Let's Chant — Let's Go
lessons.en:
To the park, to the zoo,
To the shop, me and you!
Take me, take me, off we go,
Happy, happy — yo ho ho!
lessons.cn:
去公园，去动物园，
去商店，你和我！
带我去，带我去，出发啦，
开心，开心——哟嗬嗬！

下.title: Unit 5 My Favourite Day Is Monday

lessons.title: Let's Learn
lessons.en:
Monday    Tuesday    Wednesday
Thursday    Friday    Saturday    Sunday
lessons.cn:
星期一  星期二  星期三
星期四  星期五  星期六  星期日

lessons.title: Let's Talk
lessons.en:
Andy: What day is it today?
Lily: It's Monday. My favourite day!
Andy: Why Monday?
Lily: We have music and art.
Andy: I like Saturday. I can play all day!
lessons.cn:
安迪：今天星期几？
莉莉：星期一，我最喜欢的一天！
安迪：为什么是星期一？
莉莉：我们有音乐课和美术课。
安迪：我喜欢星期六，可以玩一整天！

lessons.title: Let's Chant — Days of the Week
lessons.en:
Monday, Tuesday, off we go,
Wednesday, Thursday, in a row.
Friday, Saturday, Sunday fun,
Seven days — and then we're done!
lessons.cn:
星期一，星期二，走起来，
星期三，星期四，排排排。
星期五，星期六，星期日玩，
七天过——一周满！
